> - Finely tuned motor control breaks down most commonly due to negative emotional state of anxiety. #cognitive/anxiety 
> - What we perceive from the world, is not what it actually is, but the brain's best guess based on a trade-off between the prior probability and the hypothesis that fits the current sensory input. #perception 
> - Our brains select hypotheses in a Bayes-optimal manner, based on how well those hypotheses minimize prediction error. #baysian #prediction_error 
> - In perceptual inference, prediction errors are minimized by the organism updating their model of the world to fit input. #perception/perceptual_inference
> - In active inference, the prediction is generated and then the (predicted) state of affairs is brought about as part of the prediction error minimisation imperative. #threat #predictive_processing #cognitive/anxiety/hypervigilance  #chemicals/neurotransmitters/Norepinephrine  #neuroscience/active_inrefence_theory ^tr-omd0zzonh
